description: This file defines an interface (IRemoteInstantiation) for remote instantiation in the WPEFramework PluginHost component. It declares a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method Instantiate, along with associated enums and documentation comments.

classes.name: IRemoteInstantiation
classes.description: An interface for remote instantiation, allowing creation of remote objects with specified parameters.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates a remote instance with specified parameters such as library name, class name, callsign, interface ID, version, user, group, system root path, thread count, priority, and configuration.
